extName.message: DRM Check — DRM, anti-cheat, online and AI on Steam

extDescription.message: Shows on Steam what restricts a game: Denuvo and other DRM, kernel anti-cheat, online only, AI content, DRM-free on GOG.

hint_drm.message: Denuvo and other DRM, activation limits, required third-party accounts (EA, Ubisoft, Rockstar…).

hint_antiCheat.message: As disclosed by the developer on the Steam page.

hint_modes.message: Whether the game has single-player, from Steam categories.

hint_gog.message: Looks the title up in the public GOG catalog.

hint_lists.message: Only what stands out. Looks up visible rows two at a time and remembers results for two weeks.

privacyNote.message: Nothing about you is collected or sent anywhere. Requests go only to Steam and the GOG catalog.

factModesTip.message: Based on the game’s categories on Steam.

factNoKernelAcTip.message: Steam requires games to disclose kernel-level anti-cheat; this page has none.

factNoDrmTip.message: Steam’s own DRM may still apply; this page names no third-party DRM or required accounts.

factNoAiTip.message: The page has no AI Generated Content Disclosure.

factGogTip.message: Found on GOG as “$1”. GOG sells games without DRM; online features may still need an account.

factGogNoTip.message: No game with this exact title in the GOG catalog. It may be sold there under a different name.
